QrCode.title: QR Code
QrCode.description: Dynamic QR Code record containing unique ID, activation state, destination target URL or wallets, and subscription metadata

id.description: Unique immutable identifier generated by nanoid

is_active.description: Whether the QR code has been activated by the user

target_url.description: Smart deep link, phone number, bank URI, or web target URL

app_type.description: Category or app type (whatsapp, instagram, facebook, telegram, tiktok, snapchat, phone, website, instapay, wallet, bank, other)

label.description: Optional admin label or internal note

expires_at.description: Subscription expiration ISO timestamp or null for permanent

wallets.description: List of electronic wallet accounts (phone, provider, ownerName) present only for wallet cards

/qr_codes/{qrId}.description: Collection of dynamic QR codes indexed by unique immutable nanoid

/settings/{docId}.description: Global application settings and admin authentication hash

/platform_settings/{docId}.description: Global application and developer contact settings

/test/{docId}.description: Connection test document for health checks
